name: Jupiter
dining_districts: the Jupiter Inlet and lighthouse waterfront
intro: Jupiter cooks on the water. The inlet district under the lighthouse holds some of Florida's best-known waterfront restaurants — docks full by noon, kitchens running fresh-catch menus that need produce as fresh as the fish — while Harbourside Place and the Love Street pocket keep adding rooms. Inland, Abacoa's town center feeds the ballpark crowds and one of the state's densest golf-club populations dines at member standards.

Jupiter caps our north county route — about an hour and ten from the Pompano Beach warehouse — and earns the drive. Waterfront kitchens run heavy citrus, herb, and garnish programs alongside their staples; clubs hold spec on standing orders; and spring training season around the ballpark layers predictable step-ups every February and March.
route_note: About 70 minutes from our Pompano Beach warehouse at the top of the north county route — inlet and town-center stops land before lunch service.

faqs_unique.q: Do you deliver to Jupiter's inlet and waterfront restaurants?
faqs_unique.a: Yes. The lighthouse and inlet district, Harbourside, and Love Street are regular stops, timed so waterfront kitchens receive before the docks fill.

faqs_unique.q: Can Abacoa-area kitchens scale up for spring training season?
faqs_unique.a: Yes. Ballpark-driven kitchens layer spring training volume onto standing orders by the midnight cutoff — a planned step-up every February and March.
